name: Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20)
description: A large-scale dataset of density functional theory calculations for catalytic materials, including adsorbate relaxations, initial and relaxed structures, energies, and forces. This metadata record does not distribute dataset data.
citation: Chanussot, L., Das, A., Goyal, S., et al. (2021). Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20) Dataset and Community Challenges. ACS Catalysis, 11(10), 6059–6072. https://doi.org/10.1021/acscatal.0c04525
